scope.interpretation: Approval covers only the authorized configuration, RU UI catalog and generic locale helper. AC status ok denotes compliance within this patch, not end-to-end acceptance or a full G2 pass.

verification.patch: Exactly three additions; inspected actual files match patch content.
verification.config: Parsed config matches the explicit requested settings, ordered providers and literal environment placeholders.
verification.catalog: Exact requested messages present; diagnostic questions, choices, escalation, profile, fallback, ticketing, reindex, status, citation and legacy UI flows represented. No EN locale added.
verification.helper: Safe YAML loading, validated dotted lookup, named interpolation, escaped braces, explicit errors, failed-load atomicity, deep-copy isolation and no locale I/O on import.
verification.independent_test_rerun: 33 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; offline, bytecode/cache disabled.

The requested minimal preflight config is not yet sufficient for the baseline ConfigLoader application startup contract; backend-rest wiring and validation are intentionally deferred.
UI strings and configuration do not implement AC-S4/S6/S7, admin authorization, webhook retries, LLM routing, diagnostics or provenance verification. Their end-to-end acceptance remains unverified.
Data-zone diagnostics YAML must reference the new RU catalog keys; all-path diagnostics integration and U01 12/12 positives remain future acceptance checks.
Coverage, performance, deployment and full G2 acceptance are outside this three-file review and have not been certified.
